title.en: Moonshot AI releases Kimi K3 — the largest open-source model ever at 2.8 trillion parameters
title.zhHans: Moonshot AI 发布 Kimi K3——史上最大开源模型，2.8 万亿参数

searchSummary.en: Kimi K3 (Jul 2026) — Moonshot AI's 2.8-trillion-parameter open-source MoE model with 1M-token context, native vision, and Kimi Delta Attention architecture. The largest open-source model ever released, rivaling top US frontier systems.
searchSummary.zhHans: Kimi K3（2026 年 7 月）——Moonshot AI 的 2.8 万亿参数开源 MoE 模型，100 万 token 上下文，原生视觉，Kimi Delta Attention 架构。史上最大开源模型，与顶尖美国前沿系统竞争。

summary.en: On July 16, 2026, Moonshot AI released Kimi K3, a 2.8-trillion-parameter open-source Mixture-of-Experts model — the largest open-source model ever released. The model features a 1-million-token context window, native vision capabilities, and uses Kimi Delta Attention with Attention Residuals, activating 16 of 896 experts per token. It was launched on Kimi Code and the Kimi app. VentureBeat described it as 'rivaling top U.S. systems' on frontier AI benchmarks. The release continues the trend of Chinese AI labs releasing increasingly large open-weight models, intensifying the open-vs-closed competitive dynamic.
summary.zhHans: 2026 年 7 月 16 日，Moonshot AI 发布了 Kimi K3，一个 2.8 万亿参数的开源混合专家（MoE）模型——有史以来发布的最大开源模型。该模型具有 100 万 token 的上下文窗口、原生视觉能力，并使用 Kimi Delta Attention 和 Attention Residuals 架构，每个 token 激活 896 个专家中的 16 个。它已在 Kimi Code 和 Kimi 应用上发布。VentureBeat 称其在基准测试上与顶尖美国系统竞争。此次发布延续了中国 AI 实验室发布越来越大开源权重模型的趋势，加剧了开源与闭源的竞争态势。

narrative.en: Moonshot AI, a Beijing-based AI company, had established itself as a major player in the Chinese AI ecosystem with the Kimi series of models. Kimi K3 represented a significant leap: at 2.8 trillion parameters, it was the largest open-source model ever released, surpassing DeepSeek V4 (1.6T) by a wide margin. The architecture used Kimi Delta Attention and Attention Residuals — innovations designed to handle the computational challenges of a 2.8T MoE with 896 experts. Only 16 experts were activated per token, keeping inference costs manageable despite the massive total parameter count. The 1-million-token context window and native vision processing put K3 in direct competition with GPT-5.6, Claude Sonnet 5, and Gemini on multimodal tasks. The release was notable not just for its scale but for its timing and strategic context. It came one day after Thinking Machines Lab's Inkling launch and in the same week as the AI price war — a period of maximum competitive intensity in frontier AI. For the open-weight ecosystem, K3's release demonstrated that the ceiling for open-source model scale had not yet been reached. For the US-China AI competition, it reinforced the pattern of Chinese labs responding to export controls with architectural innovation and scale. VentureBeat explicitly framed the release as part of the intensifying rivalry between Chinese and US AI systems.
narrative.zhHans: Moonshot AI 是一家总部位于北京的 AI 公司，此前已通过 Kimi 系列模型在中国 AI 生态系统中建立了重要地位。Kimi K3 代表了显著的飞跃：2.8 万亿参数使其成为有史以来发布的最大开源模型，大幅超越 DeepSeek V4（1.6T）。该架构使用 Kimi Delta Attention 和 Attention Residuals——旨在应对拥有 896 个专家的 2.8T MoE 计算挑战的创新设计。每个 token 仅激活 16 个专家，使得尽管总参数量巨大，推理成本仍然可控。100 万 token 上下文窗口和原生视觉处理使 K3 在多模态任务上与 GPT-5.6、Claude Sonnet 5 和 Gemini 直接竞争。此次发布不仅因其规模而引人注目，还因其时机和战略背景。它恰逢 Thinking Machines Lab 的 Inkling 发布次日，并在 AI 价格战同一周——这是一个前沿 AI 竞争强度达到顶峰的时刻。对开源权重生态系统而言，K3 的发布表明开源模型规模的极限尚未达到。对中美 AI 竞争而言，它强化了中国实验室以架构创新和规模应对出口管制的模式。VentureBeat 明确将此次发布描述为中美 AI 系统之间日益激烈竞争的一部分。

description.en: At 2.8 trillion parameters, Kimi K3 is the largest open-source model ever released, demonstrating that the scale ceiling for open-weight models continues to rise and that Chinese labs can produce competitive frontier models despite US export controls.
description.zhHans: 以 2.8 万亿参数，Kimi K3 是有史以来发布的最大开源模型，表明开源权重模型的规模上限仍在上升，以及中国实验室在美国出口管制下仍能生产具竞争力的前沿模型。

description.en: Kimi K3's open-source release continues the downward pressure on AI pricing, offering a no-cost alternative to proprietary APIs for organizations capable of self-hosting.
description.zhHans: Kimi K3 的开源发布继续对 AI 定价施加下行压力，为有能力自托管的组织提供了专有 API 的免费替代方案。
